description: Dunit musl port (M6) vm: — the mallocng heap over the native Mmap syscall. userspace/ctests/musl_malloc.c does a small malloc, a 1 MiB malloc (fresh mmap), memset across the pages, calloc (zeroed), and free. Dunit's prot/MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS flag values match Linux, so SYS_mmap maps straight to the native Mmap. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_musl_malloc_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 40 --timeout 160 --boot-timeout 100

required.claim: the system booted to the terminal
malloc returned usable memory, a 1 MiB allocation (fresh Mmap) is readable/writable across all pages
calloc returned zeroed memory from the Dunit heap and survives write-back
malloc/calloc/free all work through the ported libc over the native Mmap/Munmap syscalls

forbidden.why: an allocation or zeroing check failed
